title: MiniGIM gebiedscheck (Lijst + ILS draft)
description: PoC-5 via nLDT: run the MiniGIM omgevingsanalyse for an AOI — 74 Lijst-v0.91 items auto-filled from keyless open data (PDOK BGT/BAG/BRK/CBS/NWB/RCE, gemeente Breda AGOL) plus a draft ILS-v0.8 gebiedsindeling (niveau 0-3, IfcExportAs, EPset_minigim). Deterministic, V0-V3 validated, PROV with sha256; V4 (human-in-the-loop) pending by design.

aoi.description: Plangrens (plan boundary) as GeoJSON in EPSG:28992 or WGS84 (auto-reprojected)

refresh.description: Bypass the layer cache and refetch all sources (default false)

report.description: Single-file report.html (checklist + ILS draft + map, tables readable offline)

omgevingsanalyse.description: 74-item MiniGIM Lijst artifact: deliveredStatus, values, riskFlags, prov per item

ilsDraft.description: ILS v0.8 draft gebiedsindeling (huidige situatie; v4 pending) + feature layer

validation.description: V0-V3 validator checks and verdict (exit 0 only on pass)

prov.description: PROV bundle: pinned registry sha256's, per-layer fetch manifests
